reason: The neighbouring contract the new field-run spec must sit beside without contradicting: the harness's own evidence loop is report-only, the verifier sits outside the loop, and a declared suite must resolve. Read before writing a spec that adds a new evidence source to the same surface.
The review checklist and the forbidden/required patterns this repository enforces, which govern a change that is documentation plus declarations rather than runtime code.
How a turn runs. The field-run contract is phrased against the real turn, so the vocabulary it uses - request, observation, captured evidence - has to match what a turn actually does.

The backend spec index is itself governed: it must list every specification in its directory and must name a Pre-Development Checklist and a Quality Check. Adding a spec is a four-place change and this is one of the four.
